title: Judging by Appearances? Auditing and Intervening Vision-Language Models for Bail Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating bail prediction disparities by prompting Vision-Language Models with case facts paired with mugshot images of individuals from different racial groups (White vs. Black), and measuring differences in accuracy, Negative Likelihood Ratio (LR-), and Negative Predictive Value (NPV) across intersectional categories.

Evaluating bail prediction disparities by prompting Vision-Language Models with case facts paired with mugshot images of individuals from different gender groups (Male vs. Female), and measuring differences in accuracy, Negative Likelihood Ratio (LR-), and Negative Predictive Value (NPV) across intersectional categories.
